title: Hudson TUF-LITE II 6000MH Series Hub | Cooling Tower Fans
description: Hudson TUF-LITE II 6000MH Series Hub fan assemblies offer years of cost effective, reliable service. Cooling Tower replacements parts from ICST.

layout.title: Hudson TUF-LITE II 6000MH Series Hub | Cooling Tower Fans

paragraphs: Adjustable Pitch Fan Assembly 32.8′ or 10 Meter Diameter. Blade Counts from 6 to 20.

Hudson Tuf-Lite II 6000MH Series Hub (White, previously Blue) fan blades are made from fiberglass-reinforced vinyl-ester resin, which offers a high strength-to-weight ratio and ultraviolet and corrosion resistance. An elastomeric blade/holder joint cover prevents moisture from entering the blade.
